about: Peoples: the range a culture's strangers are drawn from (KCHAR.stranger, src/10-rig.js). ancestry: each MakeHuman race share drawn from [lo, hi] (then normalised). skin: colour stops, light to dark; a stranger's tone falls anywhere along them. hair and eyes: the colours drawn from; grey: the age slider value above which hair greys. beard: odds a man wears one. morph: a slider drawn from [lo, hi] instead of the default spread. styles: hair ids drawn first (three times in four) per body. Sources: LORE.md section 6 and 7, and the owner's notes (Chichani: ashen-brown skin, dark hair; Beast Riders: vaguely Asiatic or Amerindian, blond to brown hair). Chichani eyes run to amber and red (night vision, after the Dunmer); a proposal. The rest are proposals from each culture's real-world references; change them freely. outfits: per body, per tier, the clothes (torso, legs, feet) a people's strangers wear, and the body mods a tier has (mods: a temple guard's second pair of arms); mods (of a people): the mods all its strangers have (the Hykkousoi's rib gills, tools/mods.py); a four-armed tier wears a four-armed top (KCHAR.fits); tiers: [tier, share] in draw order (KCHAR.stranger). style_share: the share of strangers whose hair is one of its styles (0.75 when absent; 1: only its styles). coat: a furred people's coat (data/fur.json coats), every stranger's.

peoples.name: Chichani (Voth)
peoples.note: Voth's people. Ashen-brown to ashen-grey skin, dark hair; Aztec and Dunmer look

peoples.name: Beast Riders
peoples.note: Hyperjungle tribes, quetzal riders. Vaguely Asiatic or Amerindian, blond to brown hair. Clothes: Mongol and Apache, animal belts (tools/make_garments.py)

peoples.name: Izani
peoples.note: The Empire of Iziz (Rome in the jungle). Olive to brown, dark hair (proposal). Clothes: tools/make_garments.py, science fantasy without the machines

peoples.name: Dalabites
peoples.note: Mound-builders: the photosynthesis mod, green skin. Clothes: Cahokian and Tiwanaku in the Moebius line, the skin bare to the sun (tools/make_garments.py)

peoples.name: Iron Republic
peoples.note: Highland state; Russian and Transylvanian Saxon, over a salvage culture. Austere and military: citizens dress as a citizen army in field grey, drab and iron black, the Republic's red only as piping; a festive folk set (*_fest tiers, about one in ten) for feast days and the Hall's ceremonies (tools/make_garments.py)

tier_labels.noble_fest: Hall of the Republic, in state

peoples.name: Free Clans (Rustic Clansmen)
peoples.note: Copper-and-tin highland clans around Ardent, northeast of the Republic (LORE.md §6.4)

peoples.name: Painted Men
peoples.note: Raider tribes of the northeast high country; PNW-coast references (proposal)

peoples.name: Eastern Nomads
peoples.note: Shade and the high desert; Petra and Bedouin references (proposal)

peoples.name: Abyssal and Reed Lake people
peoples.note: Salt-marsh scavengers, stilt-village weavers, and the lake people; Sahelian & Andean-lacquer references in teal, red-lacquer, gold, and cream (tools/garments/cultures/yuni.py)

peoples.name: Xanadu
peoples.note: The southern Sultanate of Erewhon, Pearl of Xanadu (the owner, 2026-10-19; LORE.md §6.13, settlements/xanadu): vaguely Chinese and South Asian; dress a mix of Persian, Indian, Ottoman, Tibetan and Andean Cholet/Palopo (tools/make_garments.py & tools/garments/cultures/xanadu.py): townsfolk in the kurta or chuba and pangden apron; Guildmasters of the Six Guilds (Goldsmiths, Spicers, Alchemists, Miners, Masons, Farmers) in mosaic qaba coats; the rich in silk jama and great turbans; Karavan-Bashi & Master of Mines magnates in sable-fur pelisse coats; Kora Wheel-Priests & Temple Grammarians in Tocharian-syllabary sanctum robes; Pleasure-Dome Courtesans, Musicians & Courtiers in gilded entari caftans; the Grand Vizier & Divan Chancellors in imperial khalat robes and kallavi crowns; Dzong Citadel Askari infantry in gold-damascened Chahar-Aina mirror armor; and Wardens of the Caves of Ice in fur-lined lamellar

tier_labels.magnate: Grand Karavan-Bashi & Master of Mines (Sable Pelisse Magnate)
tier_labels.vizier: Grand Vizier & Divan Chancellor (Imperial Khalat & Kallavi)
tier_labels.icewarden: Warden of the Caves of Ice (High-Pass Stalker-Hunter)

peoples.name: Jimjam
peoples.note: The Raja's city; South Asian references (proposal)

peoples.name: Hykkousoi
peoples.note: Seafarers of Ys; Greek and Polynesian references (proposal); rib gills (mods.py). Clothes: Greek and Roman with a Moebius line (tools/make_garments.py)

peoples.name: Ring Sea Islanders
peoples.note: Polynesian and Ashlander references (proposal)

peoples.name: Yuni
peoples.note: The butte city of the Outer Wall (corrupted from UNIV., the Ancient Agricultural & Mechanical College). Its people range from white Australian to Aboriginal Australian (the owner's note; MakeHuman has no Aboriginal ancestry, so that end is African-leaning with some European and a little Asian). Clothes: Australian Outback stockmen & drovers, ANZAC Light-Horse troopers in butternut & tan, Oxbridge/Gaudi trencadis academic regalia for the Emmo's court, and British-explorer alchemical geomancers (tools/garments/cultures/yuni.py)

tier_labels.trade: Caravan Drover & Station Factor (Oilskin Duster & Goggles)
tier_labels.emmo: High Emmo / Emeritus Court (Hyperboloid Crown Regalia)

peoples.name: The Eternal State
peoples.note: Qing-style bureaucratic paper state ruled from the Sanctum by the metallic-skinned True Heirs over human ministers who paint their faces white and add standardized black rank/merit/demerit markings, wearing robes embroidered with circuit-maze brocade and logographs derived from Ancient UI icons (LORE.md §6.19)

peoples.name: Yusar (Carcosa & Henge)
peoples.note: Cybernetics tribe inhabiting the ruined arcologies of Carcosa and Henge along the Eternal State frontier, speaking an avoidance dialect of swapped compounds ('Spēk-Stak') and maintaining vacuum-tube, induction-coil, drone-sensor, and server-stack tech (LORE.md §6.19)

peoples.name: Giants of Dalab
peoples.note: Engineered at Dalab, green as their makers and twice a man's height (kit.scale): the priests keep them as temple guards (four-armed) and street patrols (two-armed, in threes). Only the Giant body wears their clothes (tools/giant.py)

peoples.name: Free Giants
peoples.note: The giants who rebelled against Dalab and left for Giant Country: the same green stock, dressed as Gauls (checked wool, braccae, a sagum and torc for a chief, limed hair and long moustaches). Temple guards who escaped kept their second pair of arms and fight as warriors (tools/make_garments.py, the Giants)

peoples.name: The Order of Historians (Longsong)
peoples.note: The History Monks of Longsong (settlements/longsong): recruited from every people of Krator, so a wide range, leaning a little to the Xanadui round them (the owner, 2026-10-19); heads kept short (the men cropped, the women to a bob: style_share 1, the owner, 2026-10-20); older than most. Full Longsong & Keepwell cast (tools/make_garments.py & tools/garments/cultures/historians.py): novices, monks, elders, field agents, grand cartographers, Listeners of The Ear, Keepers of the Vault & Procrastinator, Chrono-Monks (Masters of Arms), Citadel Wardens, Festival of the Register Cham dancers, and Oidong Lower-Ward lay servants & scholars

tier_labels.servant: Oidong Lower-Ward Servant, Artisan & Lay Scholar
tier_labels.keeper: Keeper of the Vault & The Procrastinator
tier_labels.cham: Festival of the Register Cham Dancer (Shanag Black-Hat)

peoples.name: Khaayken
peoples.note: The Yeti Kingdom, Khaay Qantir, on the Outer Wall above Farside: cold-adapted and furred all over (a shaggy pelt; the owner, 2026-10-26), heavy-set, dark-skinned under the fur. Pelt colours and the rest are proposals; their 1.15 scale and their own clothes wait on the Yeti kit's Y5 (kits/yeti/PLAN.md)

peoples.name: Coyote Men
peoples.note: The Outlands' therian tribes (Sunset, Sunrise, Valley, Peak; biomes/outlands/PLAN.md section 6): furred (a coyote's brush coat; the owner, 2026-10-26), lean. The coyote head is a mod (tools/heads.py); the digitigrade legs are not built yet. Coat colours (tawny to grey, agouti) and the rest are proposals

peoples.name: Geomancers (Lithomancer Guild)
peoples.note: Heroic & faction scholar-engineers who attune resonant crystal, brass astrolabes, and tectonic strata.
